mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages ( meeting_id, participant_id, message_type, event_type, content, created_at ) VALUES ( #{meetingId}, #{participantId}, #{messageType}, #{eventType}, #{content}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT cm.message_id AS messageId, cm.meeting_id AS meetingId, cm.participant_id AS participantId,
mp.user_id AS userId,
u.nickname AS nickname,
cm.message_type AS messageType, cm.event_type AS eventType, cm.content AS content, cm.created_at AS createdAt
FROM chat_messages cm
JOIN meeting_participants mp ON cm.participant_id = mp.participant_id
JOIN users u ON mp.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE cm.meeting_id = #{meetingId}
ORDER BY cm.message_id ASC

WHERE cm.message_id = #{messageId}
